description:
We are seeking a motivated and innovative Software Engineer to support the development of next-generation AI-enabled solutions for mission-driven environments across the Department of Defense and other federal initiatives. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about software engineering, curious about Generative AI, and eager to help modernize how technology supports national security and operational effectiveness.
 You do not need to be an AI expert to succeed in this role. We are looking for engineers with strong technical foundations, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn emerging technologies in a fast-paced environment.
 This position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers, architects, and mission stakeholders to explore and implement Generative AI capabilities that improve automation, data analysis, decision support, and product innovation.
 
 Salary: 85,000 - 155,000 
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Support the design, development, testing, and deployment of modern software applications and AI-enabled tools 
 Assist with integrating Generative AI technologies into internal and customer-facing products 
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to prototype emerging capabilities 
 Develop APIs, automation workflows, and scalable backend services 
 Participate in Agile software development activities including sprint planning, standups, and code reviews 
 Research and evaluate new AI/ML frameworks, tools, and technologies 
 Contribute to cloud-native and containerized development environments 
 Help document technical solutions, system architecture, and development processes 
 Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on modernization and innovation 
 
 What Makes This Opportunity Different
 Work on meaningful technologies supporting mission modernization
 Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge Generative AI capabilities and real-world applications 
 Join a growing engineering environment focused on innovation, modernization, and emerging technology adoption 
 Collaborate with experienced technical leaders and mentors invested in your growth 
 Opportunity to help shape the future of AI-enabled federal solutions from the ground floor
 Requirements 
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, or related technical field 
 Internship, academic project, research, or personal project experience in software development 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Desire to learn and adapt to emerging technologies, particularly Generative AI 
 Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills 
 Active US Security Clearance - TS
 
 Desired Technical Exposure
 Experience or familiarity with some of the following is preferred:
 Python, Java, JavaScript, or Go 
 REST APIs and microservices 
 Git/GitLab/GitHub version control 
 Cloud environments such as AWS or Azure 
 Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized development 
 Frontend frameworks such as React or Angular 
 Data processing and automation scripting 
 AI/ML concepts or exposure to tools such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, vector databases, or LLM integrations 
 CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices 
 
 Benefits 
 401K: up to 3% discretionary profit sharing contribution + 100% match on the 1st 7% of pay
 PTO: 20 days per year
 Healthcare, dental, vision, Free for a single participant
 $50,000 Life insurance provided, additional voluntary life insurance available
 
InterImage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. InterImage provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
